book_flags: V7 NP structure: NP branches to DET + NOM except non-branching pronoun/name NPs.
Empty DET is supported for plural count and mass nouns (p.143).
PRE-DET is a sister of an NP inside NP; it may precede an empty DET (p.145).
Quantifying adjectives are AP heads under NOM and precede other APs (p.147).
Every modifier is immediately dominated by a NOM; NOM is recursive (p.149).
Compound noun is a single N node with N daughters (p.148).
